goal: Run the web application server and open the web pages for the user in the browser

steps.title: Check active HTTP server status on port 3838 and port 3000
steps.note: Checked active server status: Node HTTP daemon is actively listening on port 3838 (PID 8017) and returning HTTP 200 OK.

steps.title: Ensure robust server process running with clean URL routing
steps.note: Launched server on standard port 3000 (and port 3838) with clean URL routing for /dynamo, /agent-guard, and /. Both verified returning HTTP 200 OK.

steps.title: Open the web application in user's browser and verify HTTP responses
steps.note: Successfully opened http://localhost:3000/dynamo in user's default macOS browser with live 200 OK responses across all static assets and interactive controllers.
